title: Live-Action 'Chotto Matō yo, Harutora-kun' BL Series' Trailer Previews Ending Song
content:
MBS presented a new trailer for the live-action series of Amekiri 's Chotto Matō yo, Harutora-kun (Wait a second, Harutora-kun) boys-love manga on Friday. The trailer reveals and previews the series' ending theme song "Honeyy" by Chihiro.

The series stars Masaya Sakuragi as Harutora Kurobe and Tsubasa Nakagawa as Sui Kishida.

Other cast members include:

Keisuke Shibata and Masayoshi Kishida are directing the series. Motoko Takahashi and Riuji Yoshizaki are writing the scripts. Kо̄ji Endо̄ is composing the music. Lawyer Mimano Kawamoto serves as LGBTQ supervisor and Momoko Nishiyama serves as intimacy coordinator. Lienel performs the series' opening theme song "Ichizu no Rinbu" (Single-Minded Round Dance).

The series will premiere on the Dramaphil programming block on MBS on August 13. The series will also start on TV Kanagawa on August 13, TV Saitama on August 17, Gunma TV on August 18, Tochigi TV on August 19, and Chiba TV on August 20.

Shinshokan shipped the manga's first volume in October 2022 and the second volume in April 2025.

Seven Seas publishes Amekiri 's Hatsukoi Note manga in English and shipped the second volume in February 2025.
author: ANN

title: Shueisha Launches Manga Million Platform in Tagalog, English
content:
Japanese publishing company Shueisha announced on Thursday that it has launched its global digital manga platform " MANGA MILLION " in Tagalog and English, among other languages. The application has over one million pages of translated manga from 400 titles at launch.

The company stated that over 150 of those titles are shojo manga. The titles include ONE PIECE , Naruto , Bleach, Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba , Jujutsu Kaisen , Kingdom , Oshi no Ko , SPY×FAMILY , Chainsaw Man , Nana, Kimi ni Todoke - From Me to You , and more.

The platform is free without registration for a “limited time” but Shueisha has not specified for how long it will be free. ANN reached out to Shueisha to ask about how long the manga will be available for and the company stated that the timeline for free access has not been decided yet. The platform has over 100 languages including Chinese, Arabic, Spanish, French, Hindi, Turkish, Korean, and Polish. Shueisha also confirmed with ANN that AI translation was not used for this project. Shueisha stated in its announcement, "International licensing partners from around the world provided support for this unprecedented translation endeavor, making MANGA MILLION one of the largest initiatives in Shueisha 's history."

Editor-in-Chief of MANGA Plus by Shueisha Shuhei Hosono is the initiator of the MANGA MILLION project and he stated regarding the launch:

The project began with a simple question: what if we marked Shueisha 's 100th anniversary by translating one million pages of manga into 100 languages? As we developed the concept, we also saw it as a way to address the language barriers that still prevent many readers around the world from accessing manga. We hope that MANGA MILLION , an unprecedented translation initiative spanning 100 languages and one million pages, will spark new discoveries and connections between readers and Japanese manga.

Shueisha operates the MANGA Plus app, which is available in the Philippines in English. The app mainly focuses on shonen titles from magazines like Weekly Shonen Jump , Jump SQ. , and Weekly Young Jump , as well as the Shonen Jump+ platform.
author: ANN

Japanese publisher Kodansha is also entering the Indian market with plans to print manga locally in the country. The company is aiming to physically publish 200 manga and other titles a year in Hindi and English but will not publish e-books. It will also sell merchandise and organize events related to the IPs (intellectual properties) it publishes in India. Kodansha India will be a joint venture with Japanese company Dai Nippon Printing (DNP) and Indian company IJ Kakehashi Services.

Kodansha Ltd. launched its manga distribution service K Manga for Android, iOS, and browsers exclusively in the U.S. in May 2023 and it became available in India in February 2025.

title: Anime Limited Announces Her Blue Sky UK Home Editions in September
content:
A 4K UHD Blu-ray Standard Edition will follow at a later date, probably in 2027.

Anime Limited describes the film as follows:

"Second-year high school student Aoi Aioi is an aspiring musician. Her older sister Akane's ex-boyfriend Shinnosuke Kanomura is a struggling guitarist. Aoi and Akane's parents passed away in an accident 13 years ago, and Akane gave up her ambition of going to Tokyo with Shinnosuke to take care of Aoi. Since then, Aoi has felt indebted to her older sister.

One day, she is invited to perform at a music festival as a session musician by a famous en singer named Dankichi. At the same time, Shinnosuke returns to Aoi and Akane's town after a long time away. Then, Shinno mysteriously appears- who is actually Shinnosuke from 13 years ago after traveling from the past to the present-and Aoi falls in love for the first time.

Director Tatsuyuki Nagai , writer and director Mari Okada , and artist Masayoshi Tanaka — the members of Super Peace Busters — handled the film, which was released in Japan in 2019. (The same team's previous titles include Toradora! , Anthem of the Heart , and anohana ). Nagai directed, Okada penned the script, and Tanaka drew the original character designs and served as chief animation director. CloverWorks was in charge of animation production. Producers Hiroyuki Shimizu ( anohana , The Anthem of the Heart ) and Genki Kawamura ( your name. , Mirai ) produced the film.

"Jiraiya's fate weighs heavily on Naruto's young heart, but his sorrow turns to determination as he tries to solve Jiraiya's mysterious message. Then the unthinkable happens – the godlike Pain passes through the Leaf's defences and attacks the village directly!"

Anime Limited adds that the remaining volumes of Bleach "are well underway and just undergoing approvals currently." Regarding Oshi no Ko , "We're hard at work on (it) and hope to have more news soon." Regarding InuYasha , "We're working towards stacking up all of our remaining releases so that we can release them on a regular schedule." Finally, Anime Limited is "continuing to progress major projects including Macross Frontier and Blood+ . "

title: Chiikawa Anime Film Opens in Indonesia on August 28
content:
Indonesian film distributor CBI Pictures announced on Tuesday that it will release Eiga Chiikawa: Ningyo no Shima no Himitsu ( Chiikawa the Movie: The Secret of Mermaid Island), the first anime film adaptation of Nagano 's Chiikawa manga, in Indonesia on August 28.

The film opened in Japan on July 24, and ranked at #1 for its opening weekend. The film earned 990 million yen (about US$6.05 million) on its opening day. The film sold 1,508,500 tickets from Friday through Sunday and earned 2,240,333,500 yen (about US$13.70 million).

The film is based on the manga's arc posted on X (formerly Twitter ) from March to November 2023, nicknamed the "Siren Arc" or "Island Arc."

The film's story begins with Chiikawa and Hachiware relaxing, when a rabbit with a flyer on its face suddenly appears. Hachiware looks at the flyer, which reads, "Invitation to a special island." Lured by tempting promises including great rewards for simple hunts on the island and essentially free Sweet and Spicy dishes such as limited-edition island ramen and sweets, Chiikawa and friends decide to go to the island. Suspicious with the flyer, Rakko goes with them to the island. What awaits them when they arrive on the island?

Nagano is credited for the original story and also wrote the film's script. Under Nagano 's supervision, Kei Oikawa ( Uma Musume Pretty Derby 3 seasons, Hinamatsuri , My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU TOO! , My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU Climax ) directed the film at Cygames Pictures . QTORY inc. managed the production, and TOHO is distributing the film.

Makoto Tanaka , who voices Hachiware, performs the opening theme song "Kutsuzure" (Shoe Sore). Series creator Nagano wrote the lyrics.

Momoka Terasawa and Sayumi Suzushiro voice Hitoha and Futaba, respectively, the two islanders that Chiikawa and friends encounter.
author: ANN

title: Sega Appoints Black White Orange as Indian Licensing Agent for Angry Birds
content:
Angry Birds Movie 3 will release in Indian theaters in January 2027 with English and Hindi dubs. Sega 's Sonic Racing CrossWorlds racing game will add the character Red from Angry Birds with the Super Roaster vehicle in April.

Sega acquired the Finland-based Rovio Entertainment Oyj mobile game company through its wholly-owned subsidiary Sega Europe Limited and Sega Sammy Holdings in 2024. Rovio developed the Angry Birds mobile game, and licenses the brand as consumer products, films and animations, which includes the 2016 The Angry Birds Movie , and its 2019 sequel.

The franchise inspired the Stella ~Nana to Mahō no Eitango~ (Stella: Nana and the Magic English Words) manga. Hiyoko Hatano launched launched the series in the October issue of Kodansha 's shōjo magazine Nakayoshi . The Angry Birds Stella game debuted worldwide in the same month.

Crunchyroll entered a partnership with Black White Orange to oversee and manage licensing merchandise programs in India in October 2023. The company is also running a nationwide fan engagement campaign preceding the release of the 2026 Doraemon film, Eiga Doraemon: Shin Nobita no Kaitei Kiganjō ( Doraemon the Movie: New Nobita and the Castle of the Undersea Devil ), in India.
author: ANN

title: Akira Anime Film Streams on YouTube in India
content:
Kodansha 's Anime Manga Official YouTube channel began streaming Katsuhiro Ōtomo 's Akira anime film in Japanese with English subtitles and also with an English dub on July 1.

Japanese with English subtitles

English dub

Crunchyroll is releasing the anime in 4K and IMAX formats in North America and describes its story:

Iconic and game-changing, AKIRA is the definitive anime masterpiece! Katsuhiro Ōtomo 's landmark cyberpunk classic obliterated the boundaries of Japanese animation and forced the world to look into the future. AKIRA 's arrival shattered traditional thinking, creating space for future generations of ground-breaking movies. July, 1988— World War III breaks loose. Then, in 2019, in megalopolis Tokyo... As the leader of a group of young robust delinquents, Kaneda spent his nights tearing through the urban wastes, racing his motorbike against rival groups. One night while riding with his gang, his friend Tetsuo suddenly encounters a strange boy― the product of human experimentation— and is injured in the ensuing crash. Shortly thereafter, a military squadron appears on the scene to take the boy and Tetsuo away to an army research facility. Determined to free Tetsuo from capture, Kaneda sneaks into the army research lab. However, a regimen of extreme experimental procedures has awakened a new power in his friend, and now he is consumed by madness…

Otomo began his career as a manga creator on such works as Domu , Kibun wa mō Sensō , and his most famous title internationally, Akira . He then branched into animation by directing part of the Robot Carnival omnibus and a feature film adaptation of his own Akira story. He directed other anime projects such as the Memories omnibus, the Gundam: Mission to the Rise event short, and the Steamboy feature. He also collaborated on Harmagedon , Roujin Z , Spriggan , Metropolis , Freedom Project and Hipira: The Little Vampire .

Otomo recently founded a new feature animation studio called OVAL GEAR based in Tokyo. The studio's first title is currently in production.
author: ANN

title: 'Made in Abyss: Mezameru Shinpi' Unveils Additional Cast Pair, Theme Song, Third Trailer
content:
The official website for the Made in Abyss anime series revealed a pair of additional cast members, the theme song, and a third trailer for the Mezameru Shinpi ( Awakening Mystery ) anime movie on Friday. The movie is scheduled to open in Japanese theaters on October 23.

Tepasté: Sumire Morohoshi ( Yakusoku no Neverland ) Cravagli: Takanori Hoshino ( Mob Psycho 100 II )

Kevin Penkin feat. Mori Calliope ( Gachiakuta ) is performing the theme song "Chain of the Abyss," which is previewed in the trailer below.

Masayuki Kojima ( Monster ) returns to helms the new movie at Kinema Citrus . Hideyuki Kurata ( Goblin Slayer ) is penning the script. Kazuchika Kise ( Koukaku Kidoutai Arise ) and Yuka Kuroda ( Black Bullet main animator) are designing the characters. Kevin Penkin ( Tate no Yuusha no Nariagari ) is returning to compose the music.

Made in Abyss adapts Akihito Tsukushi 's adventure fantasy manga of the same title , which began its serialization in the Web Comic Gamma website in October 2012. Takeshobo published the 14th volume in August 2025 and will release the 15th volume on August 26.

Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the manga in English in 2017 and shipped the 14th volume on March 31. The manga has also been published in multiple foreign languages, including Chinese, Mandarin, and Korean.

title: My Sword Saint Master Is Too Cute to Live With Anime Teaser Visual Revealed
content:
The upcoming TV anime My Sword Saint Master Is Too Cute to Live With has revealed its first teaser visual following the adaptation’s announcement earlier this year.

The visual features the legendary Sword Saint Liza blushing with a sword, and you can check it out below.

Based on the light novel by Kennoji with illustrations by R_Ringo, the romantic comedy follows Eugene, who begins living with his former master Liza after she retires from adventuring. While Liza is an unrivaled swordswoman, she is surprisingly clumsy in everyday life, and her constant, unintentional displays of affection leave Eugene flustered. Seven Seas will release Volume 1 of the manga in English in June 2027. They describe the story: One young man’s desire to become strong leads him to live and train with a powerful Sword Saint. While she’s got plenty of physical prowess and strength, her ditzy personality and stunning looks make her hard to resist! A fun and sexy rom-com manga that will get your blood flowing.

The anime is being produced under Deregula, an animation label focused on more mature-themed works.

To commemorate the adaptation, illustrator R_Ringo shared a special celebratory illustration, while original author Kennoji said the series had always been written with the hope of eventually receiving an anime adaptation. You can read both comments and see the illustration below.

Kennoji:

I wrote this story with the goal of someday getting an anime adaptation, but I never actually thought it would really happen. When I first heard the news, I was incredibly surprised and happy! I have nothing but gratitude for everyone who has been involved with this work. I’m also really looking forward to watching the anime as a viewer myself. There are plans to release more and more updates from here on, so please look forward to those as well!

R_Ringo:

Congratulations on the anime adaptation! When I was first told about it, I didn’t realize they were talking about my work, so I remember being completely unable to react. I-I’m really happy now, though! I-I mean it! I would like to sincerely thank everyone involved in producing the anime, as well as all the readers who have supported this series. Thank you so, so much! I’m really looking forward to the anime!

Additional information, including the anime’s staff, cast, and release window, has yet to be announced.
author: Anime Corner

The visual features the legendary Sword Saint Liza blushing with a sword, and you can check it out below.

Based on the light novel by Kennoji with illustrations by R_Ringo, the romantic comedy follows Eugene, who begins living with his former master Liza after she retires from adventuring. While Liza is an unrivaled swordswoman, she is surprisingly clumsy in everyday life, and her constant, unintentional displays of affection leave Eugene flustered. Seven Seas will release Volume 1 of the manga in English in June 2027. They describe the story: One young man’s desire to become strong leads him to live and train with a powerful Sword Saint. While she’s got plenty of physical prowess and strength, her ditzy personality and stunning looks make her hard to resist! A fun and sexy rom-com manga that will get your blood flowing.
The anime is being produced under Deregula, an animation label focused on more mature-themed works.

To commemorate the adaptation, illustrator R_Ringo shared a special celebratory illustration, while original author Kennoji said the series had always been written with the hope of eventually receiving an anime adaptation. You can read both comments and see the illustration below.
Kennoji:

I wrote this story with the goal of someday getting an anime adaptation, but I never actually thought it would really happen. When I first heard the news, I was incredibly surprised and happy! I have nothing but gratitude for everyone who has been involved with this work. I’m also really looking forward to watching the anime as a viewer myself. There are plans to release more and more updates from here on, so please look forward to those as well!
R_Ringo:

Congratulations on the anime adaptation! When I was first told about it, I didn’t realize they were talking about my work, so I remember being completely unable to react. I-I’m really happy now, though! I-I mean it! I would like to sincerely thank everyone involved in producing the anime, as well as all the readers who have supported this series. Thank you so, so much! I’m really looking forward to the anime!
Additional information, including the anime’s staff, cast, and release window, has yet to be announced.

title: 3 Things to Know Before Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle’s Next Movie
content:
Warning: This article contains spoilers from the Demon Slayer manga! While the animation studio remains silent on any updates regarding the second installment of the Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle trilogy, the first part is all set for its global streaming date. Following the July premiere in Japanese theatres, the film made its international debut in September of the same year and eventually became the highest-grossing Japanese film of all time. The Infinity Castle is the second final arc of the manga, which focuses on the battles against the Upper Moons. Since all the Demon Slayers are trapped inside the endless labyrinth, all they can do is fight the demons while also searching for Muzan Kibutsuji.

The arc features several intense battles and spotlights almost all of the main characters. As the protagonist of the story, Tanjiro couldn’t be left behind in the action. He teamed up with Giyu in the first film to fight against Akaza. It was their most difficult battle so far, and they barely managed to survive. However, the battle against the villains is far from over.

3) Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle Part 2 Won’t Be Released This Year

It’s pretty much confirmed at this point that the best we can expect by the end of the year is to get an update on the second part of the film. Since the anime’s debut in 2019, Demon Slayer has released a new season or a film every year, but things are different this time considering the huge scale of production for the trilogy. Infinity Castle is the longest arc in the manga, and adapting it in three feature-length films can’t be easy for the animators.

However, we can expect the film to drop sometime in 2027, although it’s only speculation at this point. Shueisha will be holding its annual Jump Festa in December this year, where major Shonen Jump series take the stage and share new updates with fans. As one of the most successful anime and manga franchises of all time, we can expect Demon Slayer to be present during the event.

2) Tanjiro Won’t Have Another Major Battle in The Upcoming Film

Tanjiro will be absent for a major part of the Infinity Castle Arc, so he might not show up at all in the second film. Tanjiro had grown much more powerful since he first met Akaza, but even that wasn’t enough to defeat the villain. Even with Giyu awakening his Demon Slayer Mark during the battle, the duo wouldn’t have been able to survive if Akaza didn’t regain his memories as a human. After remembering his past, he decided to self-destruct so he could finally be at peace.

The battle was intense, and both Giyu and Tanjiro suffered grave injuries. The film ended after they passed out, and both their Kasugai Crows were incredibly worried for them. Tanjiro will have a crucial role in the film’s third installment when Muzan shows up at the scene. With the defeat of the Upper Moons, the Demon Slayers had to make sure Muzan stayed under the sun at the break of dawn. Tanjiro will again be forced into the center of action as he does everything he can to defeat the villain.

1) Infinity Castle Isn’t The Final Arc of The Manga

The final arc is divided into two parts: the Infinity Castle Arc and the Sunrise Countdown Arc. The Infinity Castle Arc alone spans 44 chapters, of which only 17 were adapted in the first installment. Despite the flashy animation and thrilling fight scenes, the fast pacing and exclusion of key scenes are impossible to overlook. The film ran for about 2 hours and 30 minutes, roughly the same length as the Infinity Train movie.

The Infinity Castle Arc still has 27 chapters left to adapt in the upcoming installments, which is an ideal amount for a film. However, the Sunrise Countdown Arc spans 22 chapters, and it seems unlikely the trilogy will be able to squeeze this arc into the upcoming parts. This arc follows the surviving members of the Demon Slayer Corps as they put everything on the line to secure victory and defeat Muzan Kibutsuji. The full stretch of 22 chapters is more tragic than anything the series has shown before, ultimately concluding the story on a bittersweet note.
